annotations.title: Explain the jet lag for a route

description: Explains the jet lag for a route without flight times: direction (eastward or westward), size of the shift, roughly how long unaided adjustment takes, and why one direction is harder, with links to Delagged's guides. Use for general questions ('how bad is jet lag from London to Tokyo?'). For an actual itinerary use plan_trip.
name: explain_jet_lag
